# Fixture provenance

This fixture preserves the filename structure of the repository's historical
`home-claude` example. Its contents are deliberately abridged and sanitized:
credentials were removed, machine paths were replaced, and vendor-specific
operational instructions were reduced to representative portable behavior.

Original repository-relative sources:

- `home-claude/CLAUDE.md.example`;
- `home-claude/settings.json.example`;
- `home-claude/statusline.js`;
- `home-claude/workitems-rendering.md`;
- `home-claude/agents/code-reviewer.md`;
- `home-claude/agents/plan-reviewer.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/backlog.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/feedback.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/init-claude.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/morning.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/my-reviews.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/pick.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/tasks.md`;
- `home-claude/commands/wrap.md`.

The statusline remains present specifically to verify that unsupported native
assets are reported and preserved.
